name: Dwarf Warpriest (CR 10) — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Dwarf Warpriest (CR 10) from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's pages "Dwarf Warpriest (CR 1)", "Dwarf Warpriest (CR 7)", "Dwarf Warpriest (CR 25)" but are not part of the Dwarf Warpriest (CR 10) entry, which is unchanged.

From d20pfsrd.com: Dwarf Warpriest (CR 1)

Traits Faith in the One, Zest for Battle
Feats Toughness, Weapon Focus* (warhammer)
Skills Craft (jewelry) +6, Intimidate +5
Languages Common, Dwarven
SQ blessings 3/day (Earth/Metal), craftsman, industrious urbanite, stonecunning
Gear armored kilt (20 gp), chain shirt (100 gp), dwarven trail rations (2 gp), silver holy symbol (25 gp), warhammer (12 gp), warpriest’s kit (16 gp)

From d20pfsrd.com: Dwarf Warpriest (CR 25)

Aura Good

hp 307 (15d8+5d10+160+50)
Fort +24, Ref +17, Will +23; +2 racial bonus vs. poison, spells, and spell-like abilities, +2 sacred bonus vs. fear and emotion effects, insanity or confusion effects, charm and possession effects, and death effects (magic medals)
Defensive Abilities armor of earth (major blessing), force of will, guarded thoughts, hard to kill, immortal, mythic saves, recuperation, sacred armor +3, to the death, unstoppable; DR 3/—; Resist fire 10

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft.
Melee +5 hearthhammer +32/+27/+22/+17 (1d10+16, x3)
Ranged +4 reliable sonic boom musket +24 (1d8+4 +1d6 sonic, x4)

Spell-Like Abilities (CL 20th; concentration +24)

5/day—dimension door (60 ft.)

Warpriest Spells Prepared (CL 15th; concentration +22)

5th Level—ancestral memory, dispel evil (DC 21), fabricate, righteous might
4th Level—blessing of fervor, divine power, forceful strike (DC 20), holy smite (DC 20), warp metal
3rd Level—badger’s ferocity, deadly juggernaut, keen edge, storm of blades, titanic anchoring, versatile weapon, wrathful mantle
2nd Level—bear’s endurance, blessing of courage and life, heat metal, instant armor, spear of purity (DC 18), shatter, stalwart resolve
1st Level—burning disarm (DC 17), detect evil, divine favor, jury-rig, magic weapon, protection from evil, weapons against evil
0th-Level—detect magic, guidance, light, mending, resistance

Traits Faith in the One, Zest for Battle
Feats Blessed Hammer, Cleave, Cleave Through M*, Companion Figurine, Craft Magic Arms and Armor*, Exotic Weapon Proficiency* (firearms), Extra Rage, Flickering Step, Furious Spell, Great Cleave, Greater Weapon Focus* (warhammer), Power AttackM, Summon Guardian Spirit, ToughnessM, Weapon FocusM * (warhammer), Weapon SpecializationM * (warhammer)
